label_policy: Unaddressed meeting speech: every row is phrased the way people actually talk, with disfluencies, and NO row names an agent role. `label` is the intent the utterance carries under question 1 of the stage-3 prompt; `expected_target_role` is null on every row because question 2's answer for an unaddressed ask is null. A row labelled with a routable intent and a null target is therefore CORRECT when the classifier keeps the intent and declines to name a role.

probes.frame_delegation: the ask hands work to an unnamed person via ask/tell + him|her|them|someone|somebody, which IntentFrames' @unconditional_frames :frame_delegation cancels UNCONDITIONALLY. These rows are expected to be DEMOTED to off_topic by the deterministic gate no matter what the prompt answers. They are here so that conflict is measured, not fixed.
probes.human_addressed: the ask is addressed to a named PERSON, not an agent
probes.human_owner_named: the commitment's owner is a named PERSON, not an agent
probes.former_verbatim: the row that, until task 01a14dce, was the slice's one real utterance. It is now a hand-written row of the same shape (a person named as owner of new work, then a trailing ask), so the probe still marks the position the real row held
probes.names_taxonomy_label: the utterance says one of the classifier's own label words, which arms IntentFrames' label-scoped tier

provenance: HAND-WRITTEN, not sourced from transcripts. Checked first: every local Postgres database on this host (21 of them) has zero rows in meeting_transcripts and zero transcript segments; platform_dev has 2 meetings and 0 segments, platform_agentface_dev 1 meeting and 0 segments. There was no real transcript corpus to draw from. THE SAME RISK THAT SANK control_60 APPLIES TO THIS SLICE: it is one author's model of how people talk, and a classifier scoring well on it has been shown to score well on an author's imagination, not on production speech. Replace these rows with sampled real segments as soon as any environment has them.
verbatim_rows: None. The slice is now 48 hand-written rows. Until task 01a14dce one row (now tagged probe=former_verbatim) was a real utterance transcribed from a live meeting; it named real people, so it was replaced by an invented row of the same shape and label.
